{
  "process": "Each row represents a Kepler Object of Interest (KOI), a candidate exoplanet system identified from the Kepler photometric time series. The sequence of events is: (1) the Kepler telescope records stellar brightness over time; (2) a transit search algorithm detects periodic dips and produces a Threshold Crossing Event (TCE); (3) the TCE is fit with a transit model to derive parameters such as period, duration, depth, and impact parameter, along with their uncertainties; (4) stellar properties (effective temperature, surface gravity, radius, etc.) are estimated from the star's photometry and spectroscopy; (5) derived planetary properties (equilibrium temperature, insolation, planet radius) are computed; (6) a series of automated and manual vetting checks (fpflags) are performed to rule out false positives; (7) the final disposition (CONFIRMED, CANDIDATE, FALSE POSITIVE) is assigned.",
  "target_known_at": "The final disposition is assigned after all vetting checks and manual review are complete.",
  "prediction_point": "The moment just before the final disposition is assigned, after all automated and manual vetting checks have been performed but before the final label is decided.",
  "columns": [
    {"name": "ra", "event": "Right ascension of the target star, known from the Kepler input catalog before any transit analysis.", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0},
    {"name": "koi_duration", "event": "Transit duration derived from fitting the transit light curve during TCE analysis.", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0},
    {"name": "koi_period_err2", "event": "Upper uncertainty on the orbital period from the transit fit.", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0},
    {"name": "koi_depth", "event": "Transit depth from the light curve fit.", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0},
    {"name": "koi_prad_err1", "event": "Lower uncertainty on planet radius, derived from transit depth and stellar radius.", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0},
    {"name": "koi_prad_err2", "event": "Upper uncertainty on planet radius, derived from transit depth and stellar radius.", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0},
    {"name": "koi_teq", "event": "Equilibrium temperature computed from stellar properties and orbital distance.", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0},
    {"name": "koi_insol", "event": "Insolation flux received by the planet, computed from stellar luminosity and orbital distance.", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0},
    {"name": "koi_srad_err1", "event": "Lower uncertainty on stellar radius from stellar characterization.", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0},
    {"name": "koi_period", "event": "Orbital period from the transit fit.", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0},
    {"name": "koi_time0bk", "event": "Transit epoch (time of first transit) from the transit fit.", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0},
    {"name": "koi_steff", "event": "Stellar effective temperature from stellar characterization.", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0},
    {"name": "koi_depth_err1", "event": "Lower uncertainty on transit depth from the fit.", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0},
    {"name": "koi_fpflag_nt", "event": "Flag indicating a non-transit false positive, set during vetting checks.", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0},
    {"name": "koi_insol_err1", "event": "Lower uncertainty on insolation, propagated from stellar and orbital parameters.", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0},
    {"name": "koi_kepmag", "event": "Kepler magnitude of the target star from the input catalog.", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0},
    {"name": "koi_fpflag_ss", "event": "Flag indicating a false positive due to a nearby star, set during vetting.", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0},
    {"name": "koi_period_err1", "event": "Lower uncertainty on orbital period from the transit fit.", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0},

    {"name": "koi_impact", "event": "Impact parameter from the transit fit.", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0},
    {"name": "koi_slogg", "event": "Stellar surface gravity from stellar characterization.", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0}
  ]
}
